payload.title: Supersession: compiled page dies, raw traces stay immutable
payload.description:
Problem: when a fact changes, yesterday’s compiled page still looks live. A cheap model keeps answering from the old concept thesis. TrajWiki’s mistake was treating the wiki as evidence and deleting or rewriting history.

Solution: when a newer page supersedes a fact, mark the old compiled page dead/outdated. Do not delete it. Do not rewrite raw traces. Traces are immutable. The compiled page is the thing that dies. Specs first. A cheap model answering from a superseded file is the fail case.
